A personal fitting chair
for every body
settings.heading: T60
settings.description:
The SIDIZ T60 designs comfort through fine adjustment. Whoever you are, whatever your build, it tunes to you for the best possible seating.

Built to hold that comfort through long hours - a chair for every body.

settings.tag: Every body is different, so the fit should be too
settings.subheading:
A personal fitting system
built around you
settings.description: Height, sitting height, the curve of the spine, the length of your limbs - every body differs. The T60 leaves the one-size discomfort of a stock chair behind with a personal fitting system that supports you precisely.
settings.alt: SIDIZ T60 adjusting to different bodies

settings.title: Infinifit Headrest
settings.description: 35 mm depth and up to 125 mm height adjustment support your neck and head whatever your height, easing neck fatigue whether you sit up to focus or lean back to rest.

settings.title: Adjustable Lumbar Support
settings.description: Seven height steps and three depth steps give lower-back support shaped to you. A flexible slit pattern flexes as you move and spreads the pressure evenly across your back.

settings.title: 3D Adjustable Armrest
settings.description: Height, angle and fore-and-aft position all glide to match your working posture and desk height, releasing tension in the shoulders and upper body in any position.
From the foam that carries your weight to the armrest pad your wrist rests on, every point of contact is shaped to reduce fatigue over a long day.

settings.title: Huggable Foam
settings.description: A three-dimensional shape follows the curve of the body, and a scooping technique deepens the cushioning while spreading pressure across hips and thighs evenly, so long sittings stay comfortable.

settings.title: Waterfall Armrest Pad
settings.description: A waterfall-shaped pad eases tension in the arm in any posture - on the phone, on a tablet, or leaning to one side - with an ergonomic curve that steadies the wrist and forearm.

settings.title: Mesh Headrest
settings.description: A mesh headrest releases heat over long sittings and stays fresh, with a generous area that supports the neck and head through any movement.

settings.heading: Move naturally, stay supported
settings.body:
The tilt is the heart of the chair: it lets the backrest and seat change angle so you keep moving rather than locking into one posture. On the T60 the tilt range and tension tune finely to your body and the moment.

Synchronised tilting - as you recline, backrest and seat tilt at different optimal angles so the body does not slide, holding the lower back and pelvis to the curve of the spine.

settings.heading: Set the range, set the tension
settings.body:
Multi-limited tilting - set the recline range from 105 to 130 degrees across five steps, from focused work to a proper rest, so the load on your lower back is controlled.

Tilting tension - up to 23 fine lever turns tune the spring of the backrest to your build and taste.

settings.title: Urethane castors
settings.description: Softer to roll and quieter than plain plastic castors, and kind to the floor - they guard against scratches across an office or study.

settings.title: Airflex mesh
settings.description: A stiff, resilient special mesh keeps its shape over years of use, with excellent airflow and an open, cool feel.

settings.question: What is the SIDIZ T60?
settings.answer: The T60 is a personal-fitting ergonomic office chair. Its headrest, lumbar support, armrests and tilt all adjust in fine steps so the chair can be tuned to your body for long, comfortable sittings.

settings.question: What is the difference between the two options?
settings.answer: The T60 comes with or without the Infinifit mesh headrest. Choose the headrest for full neck and head support; the version without suits a lower-backed setup.

settings.question: How does the personal fitting work?
settings.answer: Headrest (up to 125 mm height, 35 mm depth), lumbar support (7 height and 3 depth steps), 3D armrests and a 5-step recline from 105 to 130 degrees combine to fit a wide range of bodies.

settings.question: Is the mesh back suitable for a warm climate?
settings.answer: Yes. The Airflex mesh and mesh headrest are built for airflow, releasing heat over long sittings and staying cool - well suited to Australian conditions.

settings.question: Does it suit working from home?
settings.answer: Yes. The T60 is designed for office, home-office and studio setups where you sit and focus for long stretches.
